# Skills reference

Every `/crav1-…` command and every subagent in the kit, grouped by lane. Each command says what it reads and what it writes. Writes lists every side effect, so anything not listed is left alone.

Lanes (Specify, Plan, Build, Cross-cutting) are the routing authority, the same as [guild routing](../guild-routing.md). Groups inside a lane are reading aids. Each command links to its own page with the full behavior. Runs by itself lists the skills and subagents a command calls; naming a next command is not a call. A walkthrough is a step-by-step page; reference only means the command has no walkthrough of its own.

Generated from [skills.yaml](skills.yaml). To change a row, edit that file and run `scripts/gen-skill-docs.py`.

## Starters

When the user asks for startup options, these six are the only ways in. That ask names the list. It does not run a skill and does not move work into a lane. Each starter still follows its own rules. Every other skill is a later skill.

| Command | Lane | Use when |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`/crav1-spark-to-spec`](skills/crav1-spark-to-spec.md) | Specify | You have 1–2 sentences |
| [`/crav1-ideas-to-spec`](skills/crav1-ideas-to-spec.md) | Specify | A pile of ideas and hunches |
| [`/crav1-bundle-to-specs`](skills/crav1-bundle-to-specs.md) | Specify | Mixed files, or several v0 features |
| [`/crav1-existing-to-specs`](skills/crav1-existing-to-specs.md) | Cross-cutting | The user names existing repos, with or without a bundle to match |
| [`/crav1-read-environment`](skills/crav1-read-environment.md) | Cross-cutting | The user names the host |
| [`/crav1-fix-bug`](skills/crav1-fix-bug.md) | Cross-cutting | The user names a real bug |

## Subagents

A subagent is an isolated worker that a skill or the user starts. Reviewers write nothing. Writers change only what is listed.

| Subagent | Lane | Started by | Writes | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `crav1-spec-reviewer-agent` | Specify | The user, or a parent that delegates a spec review | Nothing | Independent product and spec critique. |
| `crav1-review-architecture-agent` | Specify | [`/crav1-review-architecture`](skills/crav1-review-architecture.md) | Nothing | Hunches versus decisions, diagrams, and ADRs. |
| `crav1-plan-reviewer-agent` | Plan | [`/crav1-review-plan`](skills/crav1-review-plan.md) | Nothing | Plan and tasks against the spec. |
| `crav1-build-task-agent` | Build | [`/crav1-build-tasks`](skills/crav1-build-tasks.md), [`/crav1-build-features`](skills/crav1-build-features.md) | That task's code, `tasks.md`, `verify.md`, `fix-log.md` when a fix runs, and the commits | One `T#` from implement to commit, in isolation. |
| `crav1-bundle-slice-agent` | Specify | [`/crav1-bundle-to-specs`](skills/crav1-bundle-to-specs.md) | `docs/specs/<slug>/` only | One v0 feature slug after the intake map. |

Subagent details:

- `crav1-spec-reviewer-agent`. Reads: `spec.md` and what the spec links to. Writes: Nothing. Leaves alone: The spec and code. Since 1.0.0.
- `crav1-review-architecture-agent`. Reads: `spec.md`, `diagrams.md`, `adr/`, and `export/` when those exist. Writes: Nothing. Leaves alone: The spec and code. Since 1.0.0.
- `crav1-plan-reviewer-agent`. Reads: `spec.md`, `plan.md`, and `tasks.md`. Writes: Nothing. Leaves alone: The plan and code. Since 1.0.0.
- `crav1-build-task-agent`. Reads: One `T#` (`spec.md`, `plan.md`, `tasks.md`). Writes: That task's code, `tasks.md`, `verify.md`, `fix-log.md` when a fix runs, and the commits. Leaves alone: `spec.md`, other `T#`s, push, and the pull request. Calls: [`/crav1-build-tasks`](skills/crav1-build-tasks.md), [`/crav1-verify-build-against-spec`](skills/crav1-verify-build-against-spec.md), [`/crav1-fix-build-gaps`](skills/crav1-fix-build-gaps.md), and [`/crav1-finalize-commit`](skills/crav1-finalize-commit.md). Since 1.0.0.
- `crav1-bundle-slice-agent`. Reads: `docs/system/` and what the parent passes for that slug. Writes: `docs/specs/<slug>/` only. Leaves alone: `docs/system/`, `work-item.md`, code, and every other slug. Since 1.0.0.
